name: Data ingestion
description: Generate synthetic e-commerce CSV (2000 orders, 25 products including Superstrike 2 line) and ingest into ClickHouse Cloud.

name: CFG grammar definition
description: Write a Lark grammar that describes valid ClickHouse SQL for the orders table. Must support SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, LIMIT, aggregate functions, date/interval arithmetic.
steps: Define grammar covering columns, aggregates, filters, date math
Test grammar parses expected SQL strings

name: GPT-5 CFG integration
description: API route that takes natural language, calls GPT-5 with the Lark grammar as a custom tool, returns generated SQL.
steps: OpenAI API call with custom tool type
Extract SQL from tool call response

name: ClickHouse query execution
description: Execute the generated SQL against ClickHouse Cloud and return results.

name: Frontend UI
description: Simple web UI: text input for natural language query, submit button, results table, show generated SQL.

name: Eval 1: Syntactic validity
description: Eval that generates SQL for 10+ natural language queries and verifies each parses as valid SQL via ClickHouse dry-run.

name: Eval 2: Semantic correctness
description: Eval with 5+ queries where expected results are known. Run generated SQL, compare output to expected values.

name: Eval 3: Edge cases & robustness
description: Eval testing ambiguous queries, out-of-scope requests, date math edge cases. Verify graceful handling.

name: Deployment
description: Deploy to Vercel. Ensure env vars are configured and app is publicly accessible.
